name: mansard_roof
description: Mansard roof (孟莎屋顶): four-direction slopes (hip-like) with a steep lower pitch (stacked stair-pair rings, ~63°) and a FLAT top deck — the defining feature ('always a shallow or flat section higher up'). Optional 45° transition rings when a smaller platform is requested. Every deck slab is carried by a hidden support stair below. Corners carry derived outer/inner shape intents.
when_to_use: Large main buildings (French/municipal/manor styles, footprint >= ~9x9, wiki: mansards only look right at ~16x20 m) with usable attic floors. origin = the wall footprint's north-west corner, y = first layer ABOVE the top wall block. Almost always pair with dormer.py for attic light (the wiki: a mansard 'will almost certainly have dormers'). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 大体量主楼/法式/市政/庄园风;多层阁楼;需要顶部平台(瞭望/天窗基座)的场合

origin.notes: 墙 footprint 西北角;y = 墙顶上一层

lower_rise.notes: 陡段环数(每环 2 高 1 收,双楼梯叠放)

platform.notes: 顶部平台尺寸;null=陡段后直接收口;必须满足两轴等量收缩,非法值报错并列合法平台

platform_material.notes: 平台面板;空=由 material 推导(_stairs->_slab)

pitfalls: 顶部必须保留平缓平台 —— 全陡收尖就变成金字塔/盔顶,不是孟莎;platform 就是孟莎的灵魂
platform 不能乱填:四坡等量收缩,合法尺寸只有 [(开口), (-2), (-4)...] 一档档,报错会全列出来
平台每格上半砖正下方都有一格隐藏承重楼梯(阁楼内看像梁),删了平台变漏顶
体量小于 ~9×9 别用孟莎(小体量做出来像违章加层);小体量要阁楼请用 gambrel
孟莎几乎必配老虎窗采光(用 dormer.py 往陡段坡上打),否则大坡面又黑又闷
底圈(第一层)檐口在墙线上;要巴黎式女儿墙走道请自行加 parapet/crenellation 卡
example: python patterns/mansard_roof.py --params '{"origin":[100,83,100],"width":13,"depth":13}' --out mansard.json && python patterns/mansard_roof.py --params '{"origin":[100,83,120],"width":11,"depth":9,"lower_rise":1,"platform":[7,5]}' --out mansard2.json
